name: 🥐 Cheeseburger Puff Pastry Pockets
tagline: All the cheeseburger flavor sealed in golden, flaky puff pastry. Kids go nuts for these.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment.
Brown the beef and onion over medium-high, breaking it up, 7 minutes. Drain the fat. Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Off the heat, stir in ketchup, mustard and pickles. Cool 10 minutes, then stir in the cheese.
Cut each pastry sheet into 4 squares. Spoon filling onto each, brush the edges with egg, fold into a triangle.
Seal with a fork, cut a little slit on top, brush with egg and sprinkle sesame seeds.
Cool 5 minutes (the filling is hot). Serve with ketchup and mustard for dipping.

kid_jobs.job: Brush on the egg and sesame seeds

chef_tip: Let the filling cool before it goes in the pastry and add the cheese last. Hot filling melts the pastry and the pockets leak.
make_ahead: Assemble and freeze unbaked on a tray; bake from frozen at 400°F for 30 minutes.
leftovers: Reheat at 375°F 10 minutes to keep them flaky; good cold in a lunch box too.
swaps: American cheese torn up instead of cheddar
serve_with: Sweet potato fries or a big salad
heads_up: Thaw the puff pastry in the fridge the night before.
